plans.idea: Faithful left-aligned column like the original: logo top-left, full-width sneaker as the visual anchor, then a big headline with the subhead tucked under it, and the CTA closing the column on the same left edge.

Headline-first editorial stack on a centered axis: logo centered at top, large headline and subhead directly beneath it, sneaker filling the middle band, and a centered CTA anchoring the bottom so nothing leaves dead space.

Hero-on-top with a two-column footer band: logo top-left, wide sneaker across the full width, then headline and subhead on the left and the CTA on the right sharing a baseline, giving a strong left-to-right finish to the read.
